title: Flexibility of affine cones over blow-ups of weighted projective planes
summary: Let $S_m^n$ be the surface obtained by blowing up $\mathbb{P}(1,1,m)$ at $n$ general smooth points, where $m\geq2$. For every very ample Cartier divisor $H$ on $S_m^n$, we prove that $\mathrm{Affcone}_H(S_m^n)$ is flexible when $n\leq m+1$. For $n=m+2$ and $n=m+3$, we prove that $\mathrm{Affcone}_H(S_m^n)$ is generically flexible.
